safety_and_limits: Not an atomic all-or-none batch. Each confirmed slot settlement is its own commit; a later failure can leave earlier SETTLED rows while IN_PROGRESS blocks fresh admission. No claim of rollback for already committed rows.
Both per-task and outer release errors remain fenced by durable IN_PROGRESS, including directory removed before failed fsync and the next startup seeing zero BOUND.

Final COMPLETE is written only after all physical releases were confirmed. Final ACK response loss yields local HOLD without rewriting a committed COMPLETE or adding a persistent storage Stop; a fresh process may recognize exact COMPLETE, never replay uncertain work.

Ordinary Stop bytes remain unchanged and prevent automatic settlement. Persistent budget_storage_unconfirmed and local HOLD refuse recovery. Existing COALESCE behavior is not reinterpreted as retry authority.

At most declared slots (1..64) active rows are selected, using LIMIT slots+1. Existing _totals/current history/effect validation remains history-dependent; this is not a global-history complexity optimization.

Domain recovery is metadata-only: validates pinned raw request/action/route/source_snapshot/declaration relationships, existing typed occurrence records and IDs; no Domain.prepare/interpret, PreparedSources rehydration, source-content or artifact-content rehash.

Observation rows are checked by the existing typed evaluator reader and exact captured set; F does not claim a fresh scientific interpretation or comprehensive revalidation of every observation adapter/spec/protocol/input binding against its publication declaration.
Current schema-2 replication mapping must remain exact; this does not create a new replication request or re-execute the source.

Unknown owner, effect, route, lifecycle or storage is not reclaimed by age/PID. No process enumeration, signals, native handle reconstruction, GO, new publication, refund, reset, repair or Director handoff.
The barrier constrains peers using the new budget API. It does not retroactively constrain a resident older version, and is not a rolling mixed-version deployment protocol or production migration.
Only the two owned production files changed. No old tests, root/peer new tests, acceptance examples, native executor, supervisor, controller protocol or shared filesystem primitive was edited.
Full Core/Pro/paired/acceptance and added Domain positive results are root-owned later validation, not claimed complete in this report.
